goal: Phoenix V3 M4 grouped/fused-continuation rerun packet

external_use_policy.statement: None of the M9, M10, M11, M18, M23, or M28 results may be cited, quoted, paraphrased, or summarized in public-facing or partner-facing material until a separate authorization changes public_speedup_claim_authorized to true.

source_identity_policy.fallback_caveat: If the pod tree has no .git directory, source identity for the run is VERSION-string plus file-hash based, not git-commit based. Reviewers must not treat source_version.txt as a verified commit.

binding_execution_environment.system_python3_failure_note: System python3 on the pod is missing CuPy and Numba. This is an environment/packaging gap, not evidence that the V3 M4 code path failed.

plain_python_invocation_policy.internal_python_subprocess_policy: M4 measurement scripts and focused tests use sys.executable for Python re-exec/subprocess paths; Makefile contains unrelated python3 targets, but the M4 packet calls only build-embree and build-optix.

pre_run_gates.purpose: Read this packet on the runner before measurement and fail if claim-boundary flags drift.
Create and verify the artifact directory before measurement.
required_checks: free space is recorded before M23 and M28 measurement

required_commands.purpose: Record GPU, driver, source identity, and Python partner environment before measurement.
required_commands.command: mkdir -p $ART && nvidia-smi > $ART/nvidia-smi.txt && PYTHONPATH=src:. python3 scripts/v3_gpu_python_env_gate.py --json-out $ART/system_python3_gpu_env_gate.json > $ART/system_python3_gpu_env_gate.stdout 2> $ART/system_python3_gpu_env_gate.stderr || true && if git rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree >/dev/null 2>&1; then git rev-parse HEAD > $ART/current_commit.txt; else echo no_git_worktree > $ART/current_commit.txt; cat VERSION > $ART/source_version.txt; printf 'expected_source_version=v3-rebuild-2026-06-20\nactual_source_version=' > $ART/source_identity_check.txt; cat VERSION >> $ART/source_identity_check.txt; printf '\n' >> $ART/source_identity_check.txt; if grep -qx 'v3-rebuild-2026-06-20' VERSION; then echo source_version_match=pass >> $ART/source_identity_check.txt; else echo source_version_match=fail >> $ART/source_identity_check.txt; exit 1; fi; { echo searched_git_and_build_provenance; find /root/rtdl_v3_rebuild_20260620 /workspace/rtdl_v2_vs_v3_pod_20260620_024503 -maxdepth 4 -type d -name .git 2>/dev/null || true; ls -l /root/rtdl_v3_rebuild_20260620/*build*.log /root/rtdl_v3_rebuild_20260620/run_current*.log 2>/dev/null || true; } > $ART/provenance_search.txt; { sha256sum VERSION README.md Makefile build/librtdl_embree.so build/librtdl_optix.so; find src scripts -type f \( -name '*.py' -o -name '*.cu' -o -name '*.cpp' -o -name '*.c' -o -name '*.hpp' -o -name '*.h' \) -print0 | sort -z | xargs -0 sha256sum; } > $ART/source_manifest.sha256; fi && PYTHONPATH=src:. /root/rtdl_v3_rebuild_20260620/.venv/bin/python scripts/v3_gpu_python_env_gate.py --json-out $ART/gpu_env_gate.json

required_commands.purpose: Read the Phoenix M4 packet on the pod runner and fail if release or public-claim flags drift.
required_commands.command: /root/rtdl_v3_rebuild_20260620/.venv/bin/python -c "import json,pathlib; p=pathlib.Path('docs/rebuild/v3/phoenix_v3_m4_grouped_continuation_rerun_packet_2026-06-20.json'); d=json.loads(p.read_text()); assert d['release_authorized'] is False; assert d['public_speedup_claim_authorized'] is False; assert d['phoenix_m7_qualified_release_rows'] == 0; print('packet claim-boundary gate ok')" > $ART/pre_run_packet_gate.txt

required_commands.purpose: Create the artifact target early, verify write permission, and record free space before large M23/M28 outputs.
required_commands.command: mkdir -p $ART && test -w $ART && df -h $ART > $ART/artifact_df_before.txt && /root/rtdl_v3_rebuild_20260620/.venv/bin/python -c "import os,shutil; path=os.environ['ART']; free=shutil.disk_usage(path).free; assert free >= 2147483648, f'insufficient artifact free space: {free}'; print(f'artifact_dir={path} free_bytes={free}')" > $ART/artifact_preflight.txt

required_commands.purpose: Build native OptiX and Embree libraries used by the P0 rows.
Run the local capability tests before expensive measurement.
Prove CuPy and Numba grouped-stream partner viability at serious scale.
Prove native OptiX producer to CuPy/Numba partner consumer same-stream handoff.
Prove measured-window no-hidden named-column movement for the grouped continuation.
Exercise the device-side grouped input contract beyond the old 8192-ray evidence.
Tie component_union to the RTDBSCAN app without Python row materialization.
Tie grouped_reduction to a non-DBSCAN app under same-contract OptiX/Embree rows.

acceptance_checks: The runner reads this packet before measurement and verifies release_authorized=false, public_speedup_claim_authorized=false, and phoenix_m7_qualified_release_rows=0.
The artifact target directory is created, writable, and has free space recorded before M23 and M28 run.

Source identity is recorded as a git commit when available; if the Phoenix pod tree is an expanded non-git worktree, VERSION must equal v3-rebuild-2026-06-20 and source_version.txt, source_identity_check.txt, provenance_search.txt, and source_manifest.sha256 must be preserved.
When the no-git fallback is used, source_manifest.sha256 includes built native libraries plus src/ and scripts/ source files, and the final report carries the file-hash caveat.
GPU partner, source identity, and claim-boundary gates are reverified on the pod using /root/rtdl_v3_rebuild_20260620/.venv/bin/python before measurement.
System python3 failure is recorded as a missing-CuPy/Numba packaging gap, not as a V3 M4 code-path failure.
No required focused test or measurement command uses plain python3/python instead of the binding venv interpreter.
All required commands finish with zero exit status or produce preserved failure artifacts.
CuPy and Numba partner rows are both present for component_union evidence.
M23 DBSCAN component-signature row and M28 RayDB grouped-reduction row both pass correctness checks.
M28 Embree/OptiX and count/sum results are recorded as independent labeled evidence rows, not merged or averaged.
At least one non-DBSCAN grouped/fused continuation row is present.
All claim-boundary fields keep public speedup, whole-app speedup, automatic partner/backend selection, and release authorization false.
The packet does not recompute the broad V2.14-vs-V3 geomean over a subset.
Any subset timing is labeled subset and cannot replace the 46-row broad denominator.
No result from this packet is cited, quoted, paraphrased, or summarized in public-facing or partner-facing material without a separate public-claim authorization.

failure_policy.if_m18_65536_fails: Record failure at 65536 rays and do not substitute, average, footnote, or backfill with the older 8192-ray evidence as serious-scale completion without a supersession review.
